"Electric 10s" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $30,000 was claimed last week. Unsold tickets still hold five of the original six. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

Everything above about "Electric 10s" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
